title: Boston 2017: archived call for presentations
body:
Archived deadline notice

The following wording is preserved from the historical submission page. It is not an invitation to submit a proposal today.

CALL FOR PRESENTATIONS IS NOW CLOSED.

The former application let speakers manage their own submissions. Submission, editing and deletion actions are closed in this archive.

Browse the Boston 2017 archive
description: Historical Boston 2017 guidance. Submissions, voting and review actions are closed.
archiveNotice: Historical Boston 2017 archive. All submission, voting and review actions for this page are closed. Instructions and deadlines below are retained only for reference.
